rules.anchor: NWSI 10-513: Ice Storm Warning = ice accumulation meeting locally defined warning criteria; significant ice is usually >= 0.25 in on an elevated flat surface.
rules.label: Ice Storm Warning
rules.time_window: alert onset to end, if it overlaps the next 36 h or the decision day

rules.anchor: NWSI 10-513: Blizzard Warning = sustained wind or frequent gusts >= 35 mph with falling/blowing snow frequently reducing visibility below 1/4 mile for 3+ hours.
rules.label: Blizzard Warning
rules.time_window: alert onset to end, if it overlaps the next 36 h or the decision day

rules.anchor: NWSI 10-513: Winter Storm Warning = snow, ice or sleet meeting locally defined event-based warning criteria (Appendix D).
rules.label: Winter Storm Warning
rules.time_window: alert onset to end, if it overlaps the next 36 h or the decision day

rules.anchor: NWSI 10-513: Winter Weather Advisory = winter precipitation below warning criteria that still causes significant inconvenience (Appendix E regional criteria).
rules.label: Winter Weather Advisory
rules.time_window: alert onset to end, if it overlaps the next 36 h or the decision day

rules.anchor: NWSI 10-513: a Watch means warning-level winter conditions are possible; treated as minor until upgraded.
rules.label: Winter Storm Watch / Ice Storm Watch / Blizzard Watch
rules.time_window: alert onset to end, if it overlaps the next 36 h or the decision day

rules.anchor: NWSI 10-513 glossary: significant ice accumulations are usually 0.25 in or greater. DMX's local ice criterion is published only as a map image in Appendix D; the national typical value is used.
rules.label: Forecast ice accumulation (24 h)
rules.time_window: forecast ice accumulation summed through the decision day (at least the next 24 h)

rules.anchor: Sperry-Piltz Ice Accumulation Index: about 0.10 in of ice is where scattered outages and very hazardous travel begin. Policy cut below the ice storm level.
rules.label: Forecast ice accumulation (24 h)
rules.time_window: forecast ice accumulation summed through the decision day (at least the next 24 h)

rules.anchor: Any measurable glaze makes the facility's unheated ramp and lot hazardous (facility.json accessibility notes). NWSI 10-513 advisories cover ice below warning criteria.
rules.label: Forecast ice accumulation (24 h)
rules.time_window: forecast ice accumulation summed through the decision day (at least the next 24 h)

rules.anchor: Commonly reported NWS Des Moines winter storm warning snow criterion (6 in in 12 h). NWSI 10-513 Appendix D points to weather.gov/snow-criteria, an interactive map we could not machine-read.
rules.label: Forecast snowfall, heaviest 12 h
rules.time_window: largest forecast snowfall in any 12 h period through the decision day

rules.anchor: Policy: twice the local warning amount; plows cannot keep commute corridors open.
rules.label: Forecast snowfall (24 h)
rules.time_window: forecast snowfall summed through the decision day (at least the next 24 h)

rules.anchor: Commonly reported Central Region winter weather advisory snow amount (3 in). NWSI 10-513 Appendix E shows the regional criteria as an image.
rules.label: Forecast snowfall (24 h)
rules.time_window: forecast snowfall summed through the decision day (at least the next 24 h)

rules.anchor: Observed freezing rain/drizzle or ice pellets (METAR present-weather codes) means ice is forming now. Policy: treat as significant.
rules.label: Observed freezing precip (hours of last 3)
rules.time_window: hours in the last 3 h with FZRA/FZDZ/PL reported at the facility ASOS

rules.anchor: Measured ice accretion at the facility's ASOS. Policy: any measured accretion is significant for walking and driving.
rules.detail: icing sensor value not reported (live only)
rules.label: Measured ice accretion (3 h)
rules.time_window: ASOS icing sensor, last 3 h (live only)

rules.anchor: NWSI 10-511: Tornado Warning = tornado imminent or occurring. Shelter, do not release staff into the storm.
rules.label: Tornado Warning
rules.time_window: alert in effect now or within the next 36 h

rules.anchor: NWSI 10-511: Severe Thunderstorm Warning = winds >= 58 mph (50 kt) and/or hail >= 1 in.
rules.label: Severe Thunderstorm Warning
rules.time_window: alert in effect now or within the next 36 h

rules.anchor: NWSI 10-515: High Wind Warning typical criteria = sustained >= 40 mph for 1 h or more, or gusts >= 58 mph.
rules.label: High Wind Warning / Extreme Wind Warning
rules.time_window: alert onset to end, if it overlaps the next 36 h or the decision day

rules.anchor: SPC watch = conditions favorable for severe storms. Treated as minor: monitor and pre-position, no posture change unless timing hits a commute.
rules.label: Tornado Watch / Severe Thunderstorm Watch
rules.time_window: watch in effect now or within the next 36 h

rules.anchor: NWSI 10-515: High Wind Watch = high wind warning criteria possible.
rules.label: High Wind Watch
rules.time_window: alert onset to end, if it overlaps the next 36 h or the decision day

rules.anchor: NWSI 10-515: Wind Advisory = sustained 30-39 mph for 1 h or more (or locally defined).
rules.label: Wind Advisory
rules.time_window: alert onset to end, if it overlaps the next 36 h or the decision day

rules.anchor: NWSI 10-511: 'Destructive' severe thunderstorm damage threat starts at 80 mph winds.
rules.label: Max gust (forecast max wind gust (24 h))
rules.time_window: max of forecast gust (through the decision day) and observed gust (last 3 h)

rules.anchor: NWSI 10-515 high wind warning typical criterion (gusts >= 58 mph); also the NWSI 10-511 severe wind threshold (50 kt).
rules.label: Forecast max wind gust (24 h)
rules.time_window: max forecast gust through the decision day (at least 24 h)

rules.anchor: NWSI 10-515 high wind warning typical criterion (sustained >= 40 mph for 1 h+).
rules.label: Forecast max sustained wind (24 h)
rules.time_window: max forecast sustained wind through the decision day (at least 24 h)

rules.anchor: NWSI 10-515 wind advisory criterion (sustained 30-39 mph).
rules.label: Forecast max sustained wind (24 h)
rules.time_window: max forecast sustained wind through the decision day (at least 24 h)

rules.anchor: Gusts of 45 mph are a common local wind advisory criterion in the central US; not stated in NWSI 10-515 (which says 'or locally defined').

rules.time_window: max forecast gust through the decision day (at least 24 h)

rules.anchor: NWSI 10-511 severe wind threshold (58 mph / 50 kt) measured at the facility.

rules.anchor: NWSI 10-515: Extreme Cold Warning = air temperature or wind chill reaching locally defined warning criteria (Appendix B). Wind Chill Warning is the pre-2024 product name.
rules.label: Extreme Cold Warning / Wind Chill Warning
rules.time_window: alert onset to end, if it overlaps the next 36 h or the decision day

rules.anchor: NWSI 10-515: Cold Weather Advisory / Extreme Cold Watch = cold below warning criteria, or warning criteria possible.

rules.time_window: alert onset to end, if it overlaps the next 36 h or the decision day

ai.rationale_paragraph: Recommendation for USDA Service Center (synthetic), Ames, IA for Thursday Dec 22: Closed (OPM: Office Closure (closed to the public); immediate departure or Shelter-In-Place as applicable). The NWS has a Blizzard Warning in effect from Thu 12:00 CST to Sat 06:00 CST (certainty: Likely). Timing: Winter / ice is extreme (Blizzard Warning) and is happening now during work hours (Thu 12:00 to Sat 09:00 (incl. road recovery)) -> CLOSED. Timing: Extreme cold is significant (Forecast lowest feels-like temperature (24 h)) and arrives during the workday or PM commute (Thu 12:00 to Fri 02:00) -> EARLY_DISMISSAL. Confidence is high (0.93); the weakest factor is agreement: gust forecast 32 vs observed 41 mph; temp forecast -10 vs observed -10 F; winter alert vs forecast ice+snow 0.00 in (disagree). If worst iowa dot condition on a commute corridor drops below 'travel advisory' (now 'travel advisory'), the posture would stay CLOSED (other triggers). This is a decision-support recommendation; the final operating-status decision rests with the facility manager.
